articles.title: This Army hawaldar breaks Shivnath Singh's 48-year-old marathon national record
articles.summary: Himachal Pradesh long-distance runner Sawan Barwal etched his name in history by shattering India's 48-year-old national marathon record at the Rotterdam Marathon. This incredible feat breaks the longest-standing mark in Indian athletics, showcasing immense dedication and perseverance. Barwal's achievement is a significant inspiration for aspiring athletes and a moment of national pride, setting a new benchmark for excellence in Indian sports.

articles.title: India’s data centre market to reach $22 billion by 2030
articles.summary: India's data centre market is projected to surge from USD 10 billion in 2025 to USD 22 billion by 2030. This robust growth is primarily fueled by rapid advancements in cloud computing and artificial intelligence. For SSB aspirants, this signifies India's increasing digital infrastructure strength and technological prowess, crucial for national development and economic resilience.

articles.title: (VIDEO) Australia Appoints First Female Army Chief Susan Coyle in Historic Military Milestone
articles.summary: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese announced Lieutenant General Susan Coyle will become the first woman to lead the Australian Army in its 125-year history. This landmark appointment signifies a major step for gender equality within global defence forces. For SSB aspirants, this highlights progressive leadership and diversity initiatives in international militaries, vital for current affairs understanding.

articles.title: GE Aerospace signs contract with Indian Air Force to help establish in-country depot for F404-IN20 engines
articles.summary: GE Aerospace has contracted with the Indian Air Force (IAF) to establish an in-country depot facility for F404-IN20 engines, which power the LCA Tejas fleet. This strategic move enables indigenous maintenance, overhaul, and repair, significantly enhancing operational readiness and reducing reliance on foreign support for the critical Tejas aircraft, thereby boosting India's self-reliance in defence manufacturing and sustainment.

articles.title: Fond du Lac’s Donte Johnson takes undefeated UFC rise to Las Vegas
articles.summary: Fond du Lac native Donte Johnson is making a pivotal move in his Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) career. He is departing his hometown this week to relocate to Las Vegas, a strategic decision positioning him closer to the UFC's headquarters. This relocation signifies an important 'next step' in his professional fighting journey, aiming to further his career within the sport's central hub.

articles.title: The 'extraordinary' rise of Kim Jong Un's mysterious teenage daughter
articles.summary: North Korean Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un's daughter, reportedly Kim Ju Ae, is increasingly appearing publicly alongside him. Though her exact identity and age remain unconfirmed, her prominent visibility is fueling international speculation regarding her potential future role in the isolated nation's dynastic succession. This development offers rare glimpses into North Korea's leadership dynamics, crucial for understanding regional stability.
